description: Read authenticated operator decisions for Slack escalations

userStories.title: Read operator decisions
userStories.description: As an unattended session, I want to read one operator decision so that I act only after human approval.
acceptanceCriteria: The reader prints approve, reject, or none with exit 0 for valid Slack responses.
Only operator reactions and leading approve or reject thread replies count; rejection takes precedence.
Slack API errors exit 2 with error and needed fields and never expose the token.
Stub HTTP tests cover decisions, other users, API failures, and missing operator identity.

userStories.title: Resolve credentials and message identity
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the scripts to use bridge credentials so that an unattended session can read a decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Both scripts resolve the bot token from the bridge config after environment and .env.
Neither script exposes a token in output or a process argument.
Dry-run and successful send JSON include the Slack ts; stub HTTP tests cover precedence.

userStories.title: Document and configure Slack
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a complete app manifest so that the gateway receives commands and decision events on its own host.
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest declares seven slash commands, commands scope, reactions:read, history scopes, and message events.
Slack guide states one app per host and explains decision setup; escalate skill documents no-poll decision use.
Manifest check and repository validation pass.
